(ii) DULY FILLED AND SIGNED INTEGRITY DECLARATION. (iii) DULY FILLED AND SIGNED LOCAL CONTENT % DECLARATION (iv) DULY FILLED AND SIGNED OTHER ATC DOCUMENTS. (v) DIMENSIONAL DRAWINGS FOR TECHNICAL SCRUTINY. (vi) ALL THE DOCUMENTS REQUIRED AS PER BIDDERS QUALIFICATION CRITERIA (BQC) S HALL BE SUBMITTED ALONG WITH THE OFFER. THIS WILL BE A REJECTION CRITERIA WIT HOUT ANY CLARIFICATION. BIDDERS QUALIFICATION CRITERIA (BQC):- CREDENTIAL IN SUPPORT OF SUPPLY OF MATERIAL TO ANY LEADING POWER UTILITIES OR COMPANIES IN THE LAST SEVEN Y EARS NEEDS TO SUBMITTED ALONG WITH THE OFFER FOR TECHNICAL SCRUTINY AT OUR END. 1) GUARANTEE CERTIFICATE: The materials shall have guarantee against defective design, faulty materials of construction, poor workmanship and unsatisfactory performance for a period of 18 m onths from the date of dispatch or 12 months from the date of use whichever is earlier. The guara ntee certificate to this effect shall be submitted by you along with the dispatch documents. 2) TEST CERTIFICATE: Manufacturer's standard test certificate / test certificate from govt. / NABL a pproved test house shall be submitted by you along with the dispatch documents. 3) TOLERANCE +/- 2% IN TOTAL WEIGHT IS ACCEPTABLE. 4) PRE-DISPATCH INSPECTION (PDI): Pre-dispatch inspection shall be carried out by Nalco’s representative(s) through virtual mode prior to despatch within 15 days of prior intimation by sup plier. All the arrangements for virtual inspection shall be done by the supplier. However, final insp ection of the materials shall be carried out by Nalco at Nalco CPP site and the result shall be final a nd binding on the supplier. Any discrepancy found during final inspection at Nalco CPP store shall l

ead to rejection of materials. All the test certificates of the tests performed during pre-dispatch inspection shall be submitted by you along with the dispatch documents. 5) Prices on GEM are inclusive of all cost component i.e. GST, freight, P&F, insurance etc. Any othe r condition mentioned anywhere in the attachment shall be ignored. 6) Vendor should submit bid only if tender additional terms & conditions and GEM general terms & conditions are acceptable. Any commercial term mentioned as an attachment shall be ignored. 7) In case of order placement, vendor shall comply to “EHS (Environment Health & Safety) GUIDEL INES TO SUPPLIERS” provided with the tender (Format attached in Buyer uploaded ATC document) ." 8) PAYMENT TERMS: As per GeM GTC. Payment of GST amount is subject to reflection of your tax i nvoice in GSTR 2A/Anx2 (GST new return) of Nalco. In case of any deviation, the offer may be liabl e for rejection. 9) LIQUIDATED DAMAGES: Delivery period is the essence of the contract and the materials should be delivered within the delivery time, failing which, NALCO without prejudice to its rights under th e contract shall have the option either to reduce the price @1 /2% of order value per week or part thereof subject to a maximum of 5% of the undelivered portion/the order value (if the item(s) cann ot be used unless full supply is made) or to cancel the Order and purchase the materials from alter native source at the risk and cost of the supplier. 10) EARNEST MONEY DEPOSIT (EMD): Bidders are required to submit interest free EMD of value Rs. 40,000/- (Rupees Forty Thousand onl y) in shape of Demand Draft / Pay Order / e-BG / through e-payment favoring "National Aluminium Company Limited" or in the form of Bank Guarantee valid for 03 months beyond validity period of the offer in NALCO’s format (as per Annexure attached under “Additional Scope of Work” of this bi d) from any of the bank approved by NALCO. EMD in the form of DD / BG should be submitted alon g with offer. Offers received without EMD shall not be considered. This deposit shall not carry any i nterest. The Public Sectors, Government agencies and the Micro & Small Enterprises registered with NS IC/ District Industries Centres (DICs)/ Khadi & Village Industries Commission(KVIC)/ Khadi & Village Industries Board (KVIB)/Coir Board/ Directorate of Handicrafts and Handloom or any other body sp ecified by Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (for the product for which they are registe red), Micro & Small Enterprises having Udyam Registration Number or as per notification, others fo r which specific exemption has been granted by NALCO and all Startups recognized by Departmen t for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Govt of India are exempted from payment of EMD. The exemption for submitting EMD may be considered only if photocopy of a valid Registration Certificate for the product is submitted along with the offe r. The original Bank Guarantee is required to be sent directly by the Bank under Speed Post or Re gistered Post to finance dept. (GM (Fin.), NALCO Captive Power Plant) OR the addressee given in th e tender document. The Bidder shall submit copy of Bank Guarantee duly self-certified mentioning dispatch reference of the Bank from where original Bank Guarantee has been sent. The EMD shall be returned to all unsuccessful bidders after finalization of the order. The EMD of successful bidder will be released after successful execution of the order. In the event of non-exec ution of order, the EMD shall stand forfeited. 11) The Contact details are as follows:- a) Technical dept. Executive (for technical queries):- Mr. Yogesh Kumar Tiwari, Contact No-943757 6291, Email:- yogesh.tiwari@nalcoindia.co.in.

b) Purchase Executive:- Mr. Subham Gupta, Email: subham.gupta@nalcoindia.co.in. c) Stores Executive (i.e. consignee):- Mr. Siba Prasad Behera, Email: sibaprasad.behera@nalcoindi a.co.in. d) Finance Executive:- Mr. Debendra Samal, Email: debendra.samal@nalcoindia.co.in. .
